title_sq: Tek "E-88" Prane Kupoles, Laprake Shitet Apartament 1+1, Me Planimetri Perfekte!!!
description_sq: Ne Rrugen Dritan Hoxha, tek "E-88", shitet super apartament 1+1 !! title_en: At "E-88" Near Kupole, Laprake, 1+1 Apartment For Sale, With Perfect Layout!!!
description_en: On Dritan Hoxha Street, at "E-88", super apartment 1+1 for sale!! The apartment is located on the 4th residential floor of a new complex with a total area of ​​82.38 m2, net 71.20 m2 and is organized by a corridor that divides into a living room with a separate kitchenette and access to the balcony, a master bedroom with access to the balcony and a main toilet. E-88 is a multifunctional project very close to the city center with a completely ecological and green facade. The positioning of the complex near the main road makes it easily accessible and suitable for both investment and residence. The area offers all the necessary services. The sale price of the property is 13,500,000 new Lek.
